title: भारी हिमपात र वर्षाले मुस्ताङको जनजीवन प्रभावित, कोरला सडक अवरुद्ध
content:
No ads found for this position मुस्ताङ । अर्नब चक्रवातको प्रभावले उपल्लो मुस्ताङमा भारी हिमपात र तल्लो क्षेत्रमा निरन्तर वर्षा हुँदा जनजीवन प्रभावित भएको छ । हिमपातका कारण कोरला नाका ठप्प भएको छ भने वर्षासँगै पहिरो खस्दा जोमसोम–कोरला सडकखण्ड अवरुद्ध भएको छ । शुक्रबार रातिदेखि लोमान्थाङ र लोघेकर दामोदरकुण्ड गाउँपालिकामा बाक्लो हिमपात भइरहेको प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी परशुराम पोखरेलले जानकारी दिए । वारागुङ मुक्तिक्षेत्र गाउँपालिका–३ छुसाङदेखि तल्लो क्षेत्रमा पनि शुक्रबार रातिदेखि नै निरन्तर वर्षा भइरहेको छ । भारी हिमपात र वर्षाका कारण मुस्ताङ भ्रमणमा रहेका पर्यटक, सर्वसाधारण तथा कोरला नाकामा मालसामान ढुवानीका लागि पुगेका कन्टेनर चालकलाई सुरक्षा सावधानी अपनाउन प्रशासनले अनुरोध गरेको छ । नेपाल–चीन सीमास्थित कोरला नाका र आसपासका क्षेत्रमा दुईदेखि तीन फिटसम्म हिउँ जमेको लोमान्थाङ गाउँपालिका–४ न्हेचुङस्थित सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलको बोर्डर आउट पोस्ट (बीओपी)ले जनाएको छ । बीओपीका प्रमुख सशस्त्र प्रहरी निरीक्षक प्रकाश धितालका अनुसार हिमपातका कारण जोखिम बढेपछि कोरलातर्फको सडकमा सवारीसाधन तथा पर्यटकको आवागमन रोकिएको छ । न्हेचुङबाट कोरला नाका जाने र न्हेचुङबाट जोमसोम झर्ने भन्सार जाँचपास भइसकेका कन्टेनर तथा विद्युतीय सवारीसाधनलाई समेत आवागमन नगर्न भनिएको छ । मौसम सामान्य नभएसम्म नेपाल–चीन सीमा व्यापार तथा निकासी–पैठारी कारोबार सञ्चालन नगर्न अनुरोध गरिएको सशस्त्र प्रहरी निरीक्षक धितालले बताए । लोमान्थाङ गाउँपालिकाका अध्यक्ष टसी गुरुङले शुक्रबार रातिदेखि सुरु भएको भारी हिमपात अझै जारी रहेको बताए । कात्तिक महिनामै पहिलोपटक यति बाक्लो हिमपात भएको हो । उपल्लो मुस्ताङका बस्ती, खर्क, पाटन र उच्च लेकका क्षेत्र हिउँले ढाकिएका छन् । हिमपातसँगै चिसो बढेपछि स्थानीयको जनजीवन प्रभावित भएको उनले बताए । यसैबीच, वर्षाका कारण जोमसोम–कोरला सडकखण्ड पनि अवरुद्ध भएको छ । घरपझोङ गाउँपालिका–४ जोमसोमदेखि माथिको सडक र वारागुङ मुक्तिक्षेत्र गाउँपालिका–३ छुसाङमा पहिरो खसेपछि यातायात अवरुद्ध भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयका सूचना अधिकारी ईश्वर महतले जानकारी दिए । Mustang. Normal life has been affected due to heavy snowfall in upper Mustang and continuous rain in lower areas due to the impact of Cyclone Arnab. The Korala border checkpoint has been closed due to snowfall, while the Jomsom-Korala road section has been blocked due to landslides caused by rain. Chief District Officer Parashuram Pokharel informed that heavy snowfall has been occurring in Lomanthang and Loghekar Damodarkunda rural municipalities since Friday night. The lower areas of Waragung Muktikshetra Rural Municipality-3, from Chhusang, have also been receiving continuous rain since Friday night. The administration has requested tourists visiting Mustang, the general public, and container drivers arriving at the Korala border crossing to transport goods to take safety precautions due to heavy snowfall and rain. The Armed Police Force Border Out Post (BOP) in Lomanthang Rural Municipality-4, Nhechung, has reported that two to three feet of snow has accumulated at the Korala checkpoint and surrounding areas on the Nepal-China border. According to BOP Chief Armed Police Inspector Prakash Dhital, the movement of vehicles and tourists on the road towards Korala has been stopped due to increased risk due to snowfall. Containers and electric vehicles that have already passed customs checks going from Nhechung to Korala and from Nhechung to Jomsom have also been asked not to move. Armed Police Inspector Dhital said that a request has been made not to conduct Nepal-China border trade and export-import transactions until the weather returns to normal. Lomanthang Rural Municipality Chairman Tasi Gurung said that the heavy snowfall that began on Friday night is still continuing. This is the first time such a thick snowfall has occurred in the month of Kartik. The settlements of Upper Mustang, Kharka, Patan and the high Lek areas are covered with snow. He said that the normal life of the locals has been affected due to the increase in cold along with the snowfall. Meanwhile, the Jomsom-Korla road section has also been blocked due to rain. Traffic was disrupted after landslides occurred on the road above Jomsom in Gharpajhong Rural Municipality-4 and in Chhusang in Waragung Muktikshetra Rural Municipality-3, informed Ishwor Mahat, Information Officer at the District Police Office.

Armed Police Inspector Dhital said that a request has been made not to conduct Nepal-China border trade and export-import transactions until the weather returns to normal. Lomanthang Rural Municipality Chairman Tasi Gurung said that the heavy snowfall that began on Friday night is still continuing. बीओपीका प्रमुख सशस्त्र प्रहरी निरीक्षक प्रकाश धितालका अनुसार हिमपातका कारण जोखिम बढेपछि कोरलातर्फको सडकमा सवारीसाधन तथा पर्यटकको आवागमन रोकिएको छ । न्हेचुङबाट कोरला नाका जाने र न्हेचुङबाट जोमसोम झर्ने भन्सार जाँचपास भइसकेका कन्टेनर तथा विद्युतीय सवारीसाधनलाई समेत आवागमन नगर्न भनिएको छ ।

मौसम सामान्य नभएसम्म नेपाल–चीन सीमा व्यापार तथा निकासी–पैठारी कारोबार सञ्चालन नगर्न अनुरोध गरिएको सशस्त्र प्रहरी निरीक्षक धितालले बताए ।

लोमान्थाङ गाउँपालिकाका अध्यक्ष टसी गुरुङले शुक्रबार रातिदेखि सुरु भएको भारी हिमपात अझै जारी रहेको बताए । कात्तिक महिनामै पहिलोपटक यति बाक्लो हिमपात भएको हो । उपल्लो मुस्ताङका बस्ती, खर्क, पाटन र उच्च लेकका क्षेत्र हिउँले ढाकिएका छन् । हिमपातसँगै चिसो बढेपछि स्थानीयको जनजीवन प्रभावित भएको उनले बताए ।

यसैबीच, वर्षाका कारण जोमसोम–कोरला सडकखण्ड पनि अवरुद्ध भएको छ । घरपझोङ गाउँपालिका–४ जोमसोमदेखि माथिको सडक र वारागुङ मुक्तिक्षेत्र गाउँपालिका–३ छुसाङमा पहिरो खसेपछि यातायात अवरुद्ध भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयका सूचना अधिकारी ईश्वर महतले जानकारी दिए ।

Mustang. Normal life has been affected due to heavy snowfall in upper Mustang and continuous rain in lower areas due to the impact of Cyclone Arnab. The Korala border checkpoint has been closed due to snowfall, while the Jomsom-Korala road section has been blocked due to landslides caused by rain. Chief District Officer Parashuram Pokharel informed that heavy snowfall has been occurring in Lomanthang and Loghekar Damodarkunda rural municipalities since Friday night. The lower areas of Waragung Muktikshetra Rural Municipality-3, from Chhusang, have also been receiving continuous rain since Friday night. The administration has requested tourists visiting Mustang, the general public, and container drivers arriving at the Korala border crossing to transport goods to take safety precautions due to heavy snowfall and rain. The Armed Police Force Border Out Post (BOP) in Lomanthang Rural Municipality-4, Nhechung, has reported that two to three feet of snow has accumulated at the Korala checkpoint and surrounding areas on the Nepal-China border. According to BOP Chief Armed Police Inspector Prakash Dhital, the movement of vehicles and tourists on the road towards Korala has been stopped due to increased risk due to snowfall. Containers and electric vehicles that have already passed customs checks going from Nhechung to Korala and from Nhechung to Jomsom have also been asked not to move. Armed Police Inspector Dhital said that a request has been made not to conduct Nepal-China border trade and export-import transactions until the weather returns to normal. Lomanthang Rural Municipality Chairman Tasi Gurung said that the heavy snowfall that began on Friday night is still continuing. This is the first time such a thick snowfall has occurred in the month of Kartik. The settlements of Upper Mustang, Kharka, Patan and the high Lek areas are covered with snow. He said that the normal life of the locals has been affected due to the increase in cold along with the snowfall. Meanwhile, the Jomsom-Korla road section has also been blocked due to rain. Traffic was disrupted after landslides occurred on the road above Jomsom in Gharpajhong Rural Municipality-4 and in Chhusang in Waragung Muktikshetra Rural Municipality-3, informed Ishwor Mahat, Information Officer at the District Police Office.
